title: Residency Guardrails Validator and Retention Orchestrator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a lightweight, continuous Residency Guardrails Validator service and a companion Retention Orchestrator to enforce per-tenant retention settings on Dedicated capacity. The validator produces signed, time-windowed assertions about node/tenant placement, active retention policies, and enforcement actions suitable for audit export. The orchestrator translates tenant retention configs into enforcement tasks (TTL rollups, object lifecycle rules, and retention markers) and provides tamper-evident evidence bundles for auditors.
acceptance_criteria: Validator runs periodic checks (default 15m) for node locality and tenant assignment and publishes a signed assertion per tenant-window
Retention Orchestrator enforces per-tenant retention settings on storage backends used by Dedicated nodes (S3 lifecycle, DB TTL, log retention) and logs enforcement events
Evidence bundles (compressed, signed) can be generated on demand and cover: latest 30 days of assertions, enforcement actions, and relevant config snapshots
Console integration: per-tenant attestation page shows last assertion timestamp, assertion status, and link to evidence bundle
End-to-end tests covering simulated zone failover, delayed telemetry, and enforced deletion recorded as evidence
design_decisions: Assertions are signed with a rotation-aware signing key managed via KMS to avoid custom key management
Store full evidence bundles in a secure S3 bucket with bucket-level encryption + object-level signing; retain metadata in Dynamo/SQL for fast indexing
Use delta-based bundles (base snapshot + change stream) to limit storage and generation time for large tenants
Validator frequency configurable per-tenant; default tuned to balance SLO for freshness vs. overhead (15m default)
Do not attempt to prove absolute physical geolocation (we rely on cloud region metadata and node placement tags) to avoid fragile proofs against cloud provider changes
tradeoffs_and_risks: Higher validator frequency improves freshness but increases load on node agents and the validator service; mitigation: adaptive sampling under CPU pressure
Signed assertions improve auditability but introduce KMS permission complexity and potential latency during key rotation; mitigation: cache recent signing tokens
Delta bundles reduce storage but complicate offline verification; mitigation: keep periodic full snapshots (weekly) for long-term archives
Relying on provider metadata means a maliciously compromised node could spoof placement; mitigation: combine metadata with network-level indicators and VM instance attestations when available
implementation_notes: Components: validator agent (runs on each Dedicated host), central validator service (aggregator + signer), retention orchestrator (enforcer + reconciler), evidence bundler (packager + signer)
Telemetry: validator emits metrics: assertions_emitted, assertion_failures, enforcement_actions_total, bundle_generation_duration
Permissions: validator service role needs KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign, S3 PutObject/GetObject, read access to node telemetry topics
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert: assertion_age_seconds > 3600 for any tenant -> P0 (stale attestations)
SLOs: 99.9% assertions emitted within 2x configured frequency
Dashboard: per-tenant attestation freshness, failed enforcement actions, evidence bundle generation time
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal alpha on staging Dedicated cluster (1 namespace) to validate signer, bundles, and UI flows
Phase 1: pilot with 3 low-risk dedicated tenants, scheduler set to 30m frequency
Phase 2: expand pilot tenants & reduce frequency to 15m where telemetry overhead is acceptable
Phase 3: GA with UI toggle in Console and tenant-level controls for frequency and retention enforcement strictness
testing_plan: Unit tests for signer rotation, assertion schema validation, and evidence integrity verification
Integration tests: simulate node moves between availability zones and verify assertion history reflects move
Chaos tests: disrupt node telemetry channel and verify validator behaves (grace periods, degraded assertions)
Privacy test: ensure evidence bundles redact PII/PII-like fields and only include tenant identifiers required for audits
